commit.message: docs(desktop): update Magi 1.7.8 workspace and screenshots

specification.objective: Update Magi 1.7.8 UI title and compaction button icon; replace the README dashboard screenshot with the two supplied authentic PNGs and display the release version, preserving behavior and history.

requirements.statement: Rename visible Memory workspace label to Magi workspace in MagiPage; leave navigation, descriptions and other UI untouched.
Add a small accessible decorative wand icon to Compact with AI, preserving its exact labels, click handler, disabled rules, focus state and compact toolbar.

Copy the two supplied screenshots verbatim under docs/screenshots/ and refer to them in README with distinct accessible alt text and consistent Markdown image display; remove only the old screenshot reference from README.
Show current Magi version 1.7.8 in README and keep plugin.yaml, changelog, previous commits, Hermes profiles and older version history unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Regression confirms Magi workspace replaces old visible title and existing navigation selectors are unchanged.
Regression confirms decorative 14px wand SVG, hidden from screen readers, beside unchanged Compact with AI/Compacting label, handler and disabled gate.
Regression checks README two distinct relative image paths with descriptive alternatives, PNG signatures and identical image dimensions.
Regression confirms README release version equals manifest 1.7.8; source history preserved and scoped checks pass.

invariants.statement: No backend, router, service, compaction logic, memory data, manifest, changelog, or other UI changes.
The existing search, compact metrics, selectors and Add entry/Compact actions preserve layout and behavior.
Screenshot bytes are identical to user-supplied local PNGs, with no new runtime dependencies.

forbidden_states.statement: The Compact with AI button loses its click, keyboard focus, disabled state, accessible text, or label during compaction.
README references missing or external screenshot paths or claims a version other than 1.7.8.
Published git history is rewritten, remote push forced, or flow/mariupol installation mutated.

inputs.statement: Clean Magi main at 2fe0f12add83d81012d97b141113cb408ad36962 with 1.7.8 manifest.
User supplied 1414x994 pending-writes.png and stored-memory.png local screenshots.

outputs.statement: Updated Desktop label and accessible wand icon.
README containing 1.7.8 and two versioned screenshots.
Focused regressions, validation evidence and published commit.

failure_semantics.statement: If screenshots are unavailable, complete the independent title/icon/version edits and report the missing images exactly.
If tests, evidence or non-force remote push fail, stop the unsafe step and report exact blocker.
